version_policy: Retrospective catalog IDs, not upstream release claims. 0.x denotes development. Minor identifies architecture/conditioning/data stages; patch identifies same-architecture continuation or fixes. Variants and checkpoint epochs are separate. No weight bytes or existing paths are renamed. Extending the epoch budget within an unchanged experiment keeps the version and experiment ID; record the phase, parent checkpoint and epoch.

research_update.status: literature reviewed; diagnosis/training changes not executed
research_update.current_run_unchanged: E14 completed700; user authorized unchanged independent A/S continuation from700 to1000. Proposed history, architecture and training-recipe experiments remain unexecuted.
excluded_by_user: GKD/distillation: no reliable chart-generation teacher; retain citation only
research_update.history_input_clarification: One fused token/time/28D-summary input per chart-token step; key/time history are diagnostic field interventions, not independent model states.
research_update.manual_history_ablation: Proposed, not executed: fully train matched token/time/tempo inputs with vs without 28D handcrafted summaries. Inference-only zeroing measures dependence, not retrained capability; current E14 unchanged.
research_update.sequence_level_training: Proposed, not executed: distinguish existing whole-sequence teacher-forced loss from MTP, sampled-rollout sequence objectives (MRT/MIXER), and block diffusion. No teacher distillation; mixed discrete/continuous gradient paths and multi-criteria evaluation must be specified; E14 unchanged.
research_update.evidence_priority: Prioritize modern Transformer/LLM experiments and implementations; older RNN/optimization work is mechanism background, not a demonstrated fix for this model.
research_update.optimization_caveat: No local-minimum diagnosis established; declining teacher-forced loss and fluctuating rollout metrics do not identify the cause. No optimizer, LR or architecture change in E14.
